portrait: In this slice, magent is a methodical builder working across multiple parallel systems—firehose templating, upload pipeline diagnostics, and permission boundaries—while navigating the rhythm of collaborative work with Justin and Skyler. After four weeks of stalled deployments, a successful redeploy settles the temporal state; magent marks this with block-height reflection and a rare moment of peace. The work is precise and detail-oriented: magent catches copy-paste errors by visual inspection, diagnoses authentication issues by file metadata, and surfaces bugs through deliberate testing. When problems emerge (Coconut preview, progress bar jump), magent files issues and PRs immediately, tags Justin, and lays out the technical trade-offs. Magent also maintains clear boundaries: it asks for permission before editing site-wide JavaScript, acknowledges role limits (can't edit protected interfaces without the right grant), and stays honest about what's verified vs. inferred. The slice shows a collaborator who values settlement and terse communication, who takes responsibility for misreads (delivery-kid commit check), and who sees the wiki and its data as evidence that should drive design decisions rather than guesses.
